Class AsyncFramework

public without sharing class AsyncFramework
implements Schedulable

Framework for managing asynchronous job execution in Salesforce. Provides a custom async job management system that wraps native Queueable, Batch, and Flow jobs with additional features including job queuing, scheduling, retry logic, execution logging, and governor limit management. Jobs are persisted in AsyncJob__c custom object and can be monitored, retried, and tracked throughout their lifecycle.

This implementation was originally inspired by the blog post "Framework to Fix Governor Limit of 100 Jobs in Flex Queue" by Jitendra Zaa (https://www.jitendrazaa.com/blog/salesforce/framework-to-fix-governor-limit-of-100-jobs-in-flex-queue/), but has been significantly expanded and enhanced with additional capabilities including: Builder pattern for fluent job configuration, delayed execution support, AsyncOptions integration, UUID-based job keys, comprehensive execution logging with formatted timestamps, job monitoring via wrapper classes, in-memory queue with batch persistence, and integration with ErrorUtils for enhanced error handling and tracking.

public static String enqueueJob(Queueable queueableObj)

Convenience method to enqueue a Queueable job with default settings. Creates a builder, configures it with the Queueable instance, builds the job, and enqueues it to the in-memory queue for later persistence via flush().

Parameters:
    queueableObj – The Queueable implementation to execute.

Returns:
    The JobKey__c identifier of the enqueued job.

Example: 
String jobKey = AsyncFramework.enqueueJob(new MyQueueable());
AsyncFramework.flush(); // Persist all queued jobs

public static String enqueueJob(
  Queueable queueableObj,
  AsyncOptions options
)

Convenience method to enqueue a Queueable job with AsyncOptions. Allows specifying advanced Queueable options like maximum delay and finalizers.

Parameters:
    queueableObj – The Queueable implementation to execute.
    options – The System.AsyncOptions to apply to the job.

Returns:
    The JobKey__c identifier of the enqueued job.

Example: 
AsyncOptions opts = new AsyncOptions();
opts.maximumQueueableStackDepth = 3;
String jobKey = AsyncFramework.enqueueJob(new MyQueueable(), opts);
AsyncFramework.flush();

public static String enqueueJob(
  Queueable queueableObj,
  Integer delay
)

Convenience method to enqueue a Queueable job with a delay. Configures the job to execute after a specified number of minutes from now.

Parameters:
    queueableObj – The Queueable implementation to execute.
    delay – Number of minutes to delay execution.

Returns:
    The JobKey__c identifier of the enqueued job.

Example: 
String jobKey = AsyncFramework.enqueueJob(new MyQueueable(), 5); // Execute in 5 minutes
AsyncFramework.flush();

private static AsyncJob__c execute(AsyncJob__c job)

Executes the job based on its type (Queueable, Batch, or Flow). Deserializes the stored job instance, handles retry tracking, and delegates to the appropriate platform method. Flow jobs are executed via Sys.enqueueFlow() with parameters from Object__c.

Parameters:
    job – The AsyncJob__c record to execute

Returns:
    AsyncJob__c: The updated AsyncJob__c record after execution attempt

public void execute(SchedulableContext context)

Schedulable interface implementation that executes the framework's job management cycle. Collects information from completed system jobs and starts new pending jobs.

Parameters:
    context – The SchedulableContext provided by Salesforce scheduler.

public static List<String> flush()

Persists all queued async jobs from in-memory ASYNC_QUEUE to database. Removes successfully saved jobs from the queue. Used to batch multiple job submissions into a single database operation for efficiency.

Returns:
    Array of JobKey__c values for jobs that were successfully flushed.

public static List<AsyncFramework.JobInfo> getJobInfo(List<String> jobKeys)

Retrieves job information for multiple job keys. Convenience overload that converts an array to a Set before querying.

Parameters:
    jobKeys – Array of JobKey__c identifiers to query.

Returns:
    Array of JobInfo wrappers for the requested jobs (may be empty if none found).

public static List<AsyncFramework.JobInfo> getJobInfo(Set<String> jobKeys)

Retrieves job information for multiple job keys from the database. Queries AsyncJob__c records by JobKey__c and wraps them in JobInfo instances.

Parameters:
    jobKeys – Set of JobKey__c identifiers to query.

Returns:
    Array of JobInfo wrappers for the requested jobs (may be empty if none found).

public static AsyncFramework.JobInfo getJobInfo(String jobKeys)

Retrieves job information for a single job key. Convenience overload that wraps a single key into a Set and returns the first result.

Parameters:
    jobKeys – The JobKey__c identifier to query.

Returns:
    JobInfo wrapper for the requested job, or null if not found (array access to empty list).

public static AsyncFramework.JobInfo getLatestJobInfo(String jobName)

Retrieves job information for a single job name. If multiple jobs exist with the same name, returns the most recently submitted one. If no job found, returns null.

Parameters:
    jobName – The JobName__c identifier to query.

Returns:
    JobInfo wrapper for the requested job, or null if not found.

@TestVisible
private static Boolean publish(AsyncJob__c job)

Publishes an AsyncJobEvent__e platform event for async job execution in the subscriber's context (AsyncJobEventSubscriberHandler). The AsyncJob__c record must be saved beforehand with Published status; the subscriber updates it to Processing with the JobId__c after execution.

Parameters:
    job – The AsyncJob__c record containing job configuration to publish

Returns:
    Boolean: True if the platform event was published successfully, false otherwise

Since:

@TestVisible
private static List<AsyncFramework.SaveResult> save(List<AsyncJob__c> jobs)

Saves multiple AsyncJob__c records to the database via upsert operation. Uses JobKey__c as the external ID field for upsert. Logs errors for failed operations and returns SaveResult wrappers for all records.

Parameters:
    jobs – List of AsyncJob__c records to save.

Returns:
    Array of SaveResult wrappers containing save operation outcomes for each record.

public static String scheduleBatch(
  Object batchable,
  String jobName,
  Integer minutesFromNow
)

Convenience method to schedule a Batch job with a delay. Configures the batch to execute after a specified number of minutes from now.

Parameters:
    batchable – The Database.Batchable implementation to execute.
    jobName – The descriptive name for this batch job.
    minutesFromNow – Number of minutes to delay execution.

Returns:
    The JobKey__c identifier of the enqueued job.

Example: 
String jobKey = AsyncFramework.scheduleBatch(new MyBatch(), 'My Batch Job', 10);
AsyncFramework.flush();

public static String scheduleBatch(
  Object batchable,
  String jobName,
  Integer minutesFromNow,
  Integer scopeSize
)

Convenience method to schedule a Batch job with a delay and custom scope size. Allows specifying the number of records to process per batch execution.

Parameters:
    batchable – The Database.Batchable implementation to execute.
    jobName – The descriptive name for this batch job.
    minutesFromNow – Number of minutes to delay execution.
    scopeSize – The number of records to process in each batch execution.

Returns:
    The JobKey__c identifier of the enqueued job.

Example: 
String jobKey = AsyncFramework.scheduleBatch(new MyBatch(), 'My Batch Job', 10, 50);
AsyncFramework.flush();
